recipes.title: Pecan Pie
recipes.note: From Grandma Pauline Herod's handwritten recipe card.
steps: Mix all ingredients for the filling together, adding the pecans last.
Bake in a 400°F (hot) oven for 15 minutes.
Reduce the heat to 350°F (moderate) and bake 30 to 35 minutes longer.
When the pie is done, the outer edge of the filling should be set and the center slightly soft.

recipes.title: Potato Cake
recipes.note: From a handwritten recipe card. The card lists ingredients and an oven temperature only, with no mixing directions or baking time, and the sugar amount is hard to read.
ingredients: Sugar (amount hard to read on the card, looks like 2 cups)
1/2 teaspoon each cloves, cinnamon and nutmeg
steps: Bake at 350 degrees. (The card doesn't give a time.)
